value.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was relied upon by villagers for settling disputes and caring for the sick, and helped make ornaments and tools for festivals.
[PAWN_nameDef] studied at a temple and helped plan halls and pagodas. Skilled at drawing plans and designing buildings, [PAWN_nameDef] left routine chores to others.
[PAWN_nameDef] fought in many battles and honed skill with the bow and sword.
[PAWN_nameDef] grew crops and repaired a house in a mountain village, taking care of daily cooking and work in the hills.
[PAWN_nameDef] listened to people's troubles, gave alms to the poor and cared for the sick at a temple, firmly refusing to take up arms.
[PAWN_nameDef] spent years digging earth, laying stone and building structures at construction sites, never working as an artist.
[PAWN_nameDef] spent years repairing houses and farm tools, diagnosing problems and improvising repairs with whatever tools were at hand.
[PAWN_nameDef] selected and cut trees in the mountains and used the timber to build houses and sheds, often being called to repair neighbors' homes.
[PAWN_nameDef] raided with bandits for many years, learning not only to fight but also to prepare camp and tend comrades' wounds.
[PAWN_nameDef] worked the fields while experimenting with crops, comparing soil, fertilizer and sowing dates and recording the results.
[PAWN_nameDef] ran a manor kitchen, preparing everyday meals and banquet dishes with exacting tastes and a gift for presentation.
[PAWN_nameDef] studied medicine at a temple and tended the sick and injured, devoting life to treatment instead of taking up arms.
[PAWN_nameDef] guarded a castle for years, excelling with bows and repairing palisades and earthworks, but was unsociable and left nursing to others.
[PAWN_nameDef] served a lord by managing letters and supplies and dealing with people, while also practicing arms and making tools.
[PAWN_nameDef] mastered singing and dancing and performed at feasts and festivals, captivating others with beauty and artistry.
Serving no particular lord, [PAWN_nameDef] took jobs as a guard or enforcer, handling weapons, bargaining with clients and caring for personal equipment.
[PAWN_nameDef] loved books and devoted life to writing tales, leaving negotiations and chores to others to focus on the brush.
[PAWN_nameDef] fought many battles with bow and blade. Though skilled in combat, [PAWN_nameDef] neither negotiates nor tends the wounded.
[PAWN_nameDef] negotiated with powerful figures as a lord's envoy, managing correspondence and persuading others with words.
[PAWN_nameDef] led foot soldiers through many battles, mastering weapons and directing comrades on the battlefield.
[PAWN_nameDef] led a temple, advised people and tended the sick, preparing medicines and meals but remaining unfamiliar with warfare and heavy labor.
[PAWN_nameDef] left a troupe and traveled the provinces performing song and dance, making friends easily and learning archery for self-defense.
[PAWN_nameDef] spent years carving stone Buddhas, learning the properties of stone and leaving chores to apprentices to concentrate on art.
[PAWN_nameDef] survived many battles and became a formidable fighter but remains unsociable and slow to trust others.
[PAWN_nameDef] watched travelers and cargo passing a checkpoint, settling disputes and treating injuries, but feared fire and refused to help extinguish it.
[PAWN_nameDef] performed song and dance with a troupe from childhood, becoming comfortable before crowds but learning little scholarship or household work.
[PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a merchant household, meeting customers and naturally learning to converse and keep accounts.
[PAWN_nameDef] grew up playing in town alleys, fighting often and learning to throw stones and wield sticks.
[PAWN_nameDef] quarried stone and built foundations and stone walls, speaking little and preferring quiet work.
[PAWN_nameDef] bought and sold goods at markets, mastering prices, accounts and negotiation.
[PAWN_nameDef] spent many years building houses, shrines and temples, with skill in working timber and assembling buildings.
[PAWN_nameDef] led bandits who robbed travelers and merchants, adept at fighting and commanding men and leaving routine chores to followers.
[PAWN_nameDef] dug ore for years and could judge where to tunnel by reading the rock.
[PAWN_nameDef] studied plants and animals in the wild and in books, disliking harm to living things and violence.
[PAWN_nameDef] spent years in mines, learning the tunnels and mining routines, enjoying underground life and getting to know fellow workers.
[PAWN_nameDef] was fascinated by tools and buildings from childhood and made things by imitation, ignoring fieldwork and cleaning.
[PAWN_nameDef] trained as a painter and earned a living with the brush, but was unfamiliar with farming and construction.
[PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a farm family helping with crops and cooking, with little schooling and a dislike of fighting.
[PAWN_nameDef] learned song and dance in a wealthy household, blessed with beauty and accustomed to audiences rather than chores or labor.
[PAWN_nameDef] devoted childhood to martial practice and studies, taking little interest in socializing or the arts.
[PAWN_nameDef] studied old and new medical texts and treated many patients, spending much time on medicine rather than farm or kitchen work.
[PAWN_nameDef] managed accounts, letters and dues for an estate, becoming adept at reading, writing and negotiation rather than repairs.
[PAWN_nameDef] often painted alone as a child. Though shy and averse to conflict, [PAWN_nameDef] showed recognized talent.
[PAWN_nameDef] grew up with books, arts and lessons in manners, but little exposure to labor or fighting.
[PAWN_nameDef] struggled with the dress others expected and began making clothing and ornaments that felt right, preferring crafts to cooking or farming.
[PAWN_nameDef] grew up at an austere mountain temple, studying books, martial arts and wound care and learning to live without luxuries.
[PAWN_nameDef] led troops in many battles and earned fame for archery and command, leaving mundane chores to subordinates.
[PAWN_nameDef] showed talent at song and dance and attracted notice for beauty, being headstrong, good at fighting and fond of praise and rewards.
[PAWN_nameDef] studied medical texts and helped care for patients, becoming accustomed to dealing with their families.
[PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a forge, making tools and helping with repairs, favoring strong and useful things over ornaments.
[PAWN_nameDef] traveled among villages, doing fieldwork, cooking and tending injuries, but remained uncomfortable around others.
[PAWN_nameDef] sold bows, swords and spears, familiar with weapons and negotiating prices.
[PAWN_nameDef] loved sumo, testing strength with village children and chatting readily with adults.
[PAWN_nameDef] received commissions from temples and manors, negotiated high payments, read widely and sought greater wealth.
[PAWN_nameDef] grew up in the mountains, enjoying books and martial practice and learning to treat wounds while avoiding socializing and art.
[PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a snowy region, studying books and how buildings and tools work while preferring solitude.
[PAWN_nameDef] grew up in back alleys, repairing discarded tools and getting into fights, with little knowledge of farming.
[PAWN_nameDef] worked from childhood at construction sites, digging and carrying stone and helping build structures, with little time for the arts.
[PAWN_nameDef] learned quickly and loved books, skilled at dealing with people but indifferent to their suffering.
[PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a warrior household and practiced archery and swordsmanship from childhood, excelling at both.
[PAWN_nameDef] handled accounts and calendar calculations with skill and loved learning but disliked menial tasks and warfare.
[PAWN_nameDef] built structures, waterwheels and wooden tools and excelled at figuring out and repairing mechanisms.
[PAWN_nameDef] studied medical texts and patient care with a healing monk and learned to welcome visitors but rarely did physical labor.
[PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a family of physicians, learning medicines and wound care and honing skills while helping family.
[PAWN_nameDef] followed armies making and repairing arms and armor, and could fight, cook at camp and tend injuries.
[PAWN_nameDef] helped armies build palisades and camps and made sturdy and practical tools for the work.
[PAWN_nameDef] killed for a living, mastered ranged and close combat and remained indifferent to others' pain and daily chores and art.
[PAWN_nameDef] studied tools and bodies with books and experiments, often talking endlessly about interests but finding social life difficult.
[PAWN_nameDef] grew up helping other orphans, defending vulnerable children and learning wound care.
[PAWN_nameDef] studied strategy and martial arts and understood formations and directing troops but was unused to heavy labor.
[PAWN_nameDef] was carefully raised in a wealthy household, taught books, manners and medicines but not cooking or fighting.
[PAWN_nameDef] read books in a temple and joined discussions with adults, preferring words over violence.
[PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a court noble's family learning scholarship, arts and a little medicine, without manual work or martial training.
[PAWN_nameDef] withdrew from society and lived far from settlements, avoiding people and conflict and knowing little about cooking or crafts.
[PAWN_nameDef] grew up around kilns and learned repairs and burn treatment but always loved flames and refused to extinguish them.
[PAWN_nameDef] worked for others from childhood, tending fields and tools but resisting unjust orders and supporting fellow servants.
[PAWN_nameDef] learned quickly, studying books, medicine and art, and avoided fights and dangerous fires.
[PAWN_nameDef] helped cook since childhood, learning to prepare rice, vegetables and daily meals.
[PAWN_nameDef] patrolled town, caught thieves, broke up fights and learned to settle disputes through both martial skill and discussion.
[PAWN_nameDef] read medical books and prepared herbal remedies, becoming knowledgeable about medicine but poor at physical labor and fighting.
[PAWN_nameDef] traveled trading discreetly, bargaining skillfully and learning some self-defense and wound care.
[PAWN_nameDef] grew up among bandits and learned bow and blade, but struggled with socializing and caring for others.
[PAWN_nameDef] traveled with family peddlers, making and selling goods, haggling and learning to fight off trouble on the road.
[PAWN_nameDef] grew up wealthy and studied medicine, books and treatments while leaving cleaning and hauling to others.
[PAWN_nameDef] grew up hosting guests in a high-status family, mastering conversation but leaving ordinary work to others.
[PAWN_nameDef] worked in wood for years, from farm tools to house timbers, becoming known for fine craftsmanship and sought-after skill.
[PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a remote hut reading books and tending animals, with little social contact and a lasting preference for solitude.
[PAWN_nameDef] was entrusted to a temple by a powerful family, learning literacy and scholarship from monks and greeting visitors but doing little physical work.
[PAWN_nameDef] led a naval ship through sea battles, understanding construction and sea routes and commanding the soldiers aboard.
